After completing his BCA in 2021, he faced a 3-year career gap , making it challenging to enter the competitive IT industry. Instead of giving up, he focused on building industry-relevant skills through structured learning. Today, he has successfully launched his IT career as a Consultant – DevOps at AIQoD , an MNC known for delivering innovative technology solutions. Background After earning his Bachelor’s degree in Computer Applications, Ashutosh struggled to find the right opportunity due to his extended career gap. He understood that employers were looking for candidates with practical skills and hands-on experience rather than academic qualifications alone. Determined to restart his career, he researched the most in-demand IT domains and found that a DevOps course in Pune could provide the practical exposure and career opportunities he was looking for. Upskilling with 3RI Technologies Ashutosh joined the Step in DevOps Engineering program at 3RI Technologies to gain real-world DevOps expertise. The training covered Git, Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, AWS, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and automation through live projects. Regular coding practice, technical mentoring, mock interviews, and placement-focused sessions helped him strengthen both his technical knowledge and interview confidence. The practical learning environment played a vital role in preparing him for industry expectations. Transition to Company With consistent effort and guidance from the placement team, Ashutosh successfully secured a position with AIQoD . His strong understanding of DevOps practices, project-based learning, and problem-solving abilities helped him perform well during the interview process. Despite having a three-year career gap, he proved that dedication, continuous learning, and the right mentorship can open doors to rewarding opportunities in the IT industry. Achievements as a Consultant – DevOps As a Consultant – DevOps at AIQoD , Ashutosh contributes to streamlining software delivery through automation and modern DevOps practices. He works with cloud technologies, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and deployment processes to improve operational efficiency. His ability to restart his career after a significant gap demonstrates that determination and practical skills can outweigh career breaks. His journey inspires many aspiring IT professionals to confidently pursue a career after completing a DevOps course in Pune . Conclusion Ashutosh Gore’s journey proves that a career gap does not have to become a career barrier. By investing in practical learning, staying committed to his goals, and receiving expert guidance from 3RI Technologies, he successfully transformed his career and secured a role as a Consultant – DevOps at AIQoD . His story encourages graduates and career break candidates to focus on building the right skills and believe in their ability to achieve success in the technology industry.
